messages:
Maya Chen: opening a small focused PR to consolidate Optimize toolkit guidance: batching heuristics, cache defaults, and three starter quant profiles. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
Sam Patel: nice. please include one-line numbers for short/mid/long workloads so teams can copy them into tickets.
Maya Chen: will add a compact table (p95, tok/sec, $/1k) for short (<=64), mid (<=512), long (>=1500).
Ivy Lopez: we should include a 4-line Python SDK example for batch + kv prefetch. customers paste that a lot.
Maya Chen: adding tiny snippet and a short FAQ entry: "why didn't my batch form" (cross-client batching, oversized tokens, per-request limits).
docs-bot: CI: docs-check #472 failed - markdown-link-check: docs/optimize/heuristics.md line 37 points to /console/v1/optimize
Sam Patel: swap to /console/v2 and add a redirect. also check images for embedded v1 links.
Maya Chen: noted. I'll update links and add a migration mini-checklist mapping q8 -> q4 profiles with a fallback_to_fp16 tip. aiming to move draft -> ready tomorrow, ping for reviewers.
